decisive_items: High titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody
Multinucleated giant cells between necrotic tissue and viable inflammatory cells
response.rationale: The combination of rheumatoid arthritis-associated serology and leptomeningeal biopsy showing necrotic tissue surrounded by multinucleated giant cells and chronic inflammation strongly supports rheumatoid meningitis over neurosarcoidosis, MS, or vasculitis.

rejected.why: Biopsy explicitly shows no evidence of vasculitis and MRA is normal, making CNS vasculitis unlikely.
Oligoclonal bands correspond to serum rather than being CSF-specific, and biopsy shows no demyelinating pattern; imaging shows leptomeningeal rather than pure white-matter demyelination.

Although leptomeningeal enhancement and giant cells can occur in neurosarcoidosis, the necrotic center with surrounding multinucleated giant cells and high-titer CCP antibody favors rheumatoid meningitis.
